name: terminus
notes: The terminus (hard clock, alien victory). In the 2039 Jupiter save the aliens escalate on the first monthly tick, so the terminus begins then and is funded at 30% of the drip (~20 exotics/month vs a Normal cost of 2400). @60 forces progress to 0.24 to cross the 25% milestone naturally; @120 forces 0.995 so it completes on the next monthly tick (unattended harness: journaled, campaign not ended).
info: [(e['t'], e['ev'], round(e.get('after', 0), 3), round(e.get('invest', 0), 1)) for e in events('terminus')]
